giasip-giasip-skills-giasip-dispatch.description: “Multi-model dispatcher -- sends a task or prompt to other AI models (Codex / Gemini / Kimi / DeepSeek / Doubao / Qwen / GLM / MiniMax) and retrieves results. Triggers when you want to run a task on a specific model, need multi-model cross-validation, or want to use a cheaper model.”
giasip-giasip-skills-giasip-dispatch.author: GiaSip <https://github.com/GiaSip>

giasip-giasip-skills-giasip-research.description: Use when the user asks to research, investigate, compare competitors, study a market or industry, check the current status of a regulation or policy, search literature, or simply look something up that needs external sources. Any question that requires fetching outside information triggers this skill. To verify specific claims in an existing report, use a dedicated verification pass instead.
